name: KiCad AI PCB Copilot & Auto-Router
description: AI & Physics-informed intelligent PCB routing copilot for KiCad 7 & 8
description_full: KiCad AI PCB Copilot & Auto-Router automates high-speed and power layout while preserving 100% of human component placement. Features include IPC-2152 current-density trace sizing, 50 Ohm RF Coplanar Waveguide (CPWG) with stitching via shielding fence, Star Net-Tie grounding, crystal keepout guard rings, and differential pair serpentine skew tuning.
